We’re a remote-first company that connects talent, technology, and purpose to help companies grow sustainably. We also believe recruitment should be more than matching keywords to job descriptions. It's about understanding people, recognising potential, and creating the right conditions for long-term success. Here, ownership matters more than control, and progress matters more than perfection. People powered, tech enabled. About the Role We're looking for someone who can bring their expertise, ambition, and unique perspective to one of the project teams we support. At MOZAYDO, we believe great careers are built where talent, purpose, and opportunity meet. While we're currently hiring for a specific project environment, our focus goes beyond matching skills to requirements. We want to understand where you can create the most impact and continue growing. We are looking for 2 Senior Workplace Engineers to support and evolve workplace services within an international company operating in the aerospace and space technology sector. You will take hands-on ownership of Windows client engineering and endpoint management, combining strong technical expertise with the autonomy required to resolve complex incidents, coordinate suppliers and stakeholders, and contribute to workplace technology projects. The role covers the full lifecycle of workplace services, including endpoint configuration and security, software packaging and deployment, mobile devices, printing solutions and meeting-room technology. You will also participate in proofs of concept, test campaigns, lifecycle initiatives and future rollouts. Responsibilities Engineer, administer and maintain Windows client environments. Manage endpoints through Microsoft SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Intune. Configure and support Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID services and Group Policy. Package, test and distribute applications and software updates. Maintain endpoint security, compliance and configuration standards. Investigate and resolve complex Level 2 and Level 3 workplace incidents. Support mobile devices, printing solutions and meeting-room technologies. Participate in proofs of concept, test campaigns, lifecycle projects and workplace technology rollouts. Coordinate suppliers and internal stakeholders until incidents and service requests reach a clear resolution. Create and maintain technical procedures, operational documentation and end-user guidance. Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and continuous service improvement. Work autonomously across different technical domains, particularly where requirements, ownership or processes are not fully defined. Requirements More than five years of professional experience in workplace engineering, endpoint management or a comparable role. Strong hands-on experience with Windows client engineering. Demonstrated experience administering Microsoft SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Intune. Solid knowledge of Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID. Practical experience with Group Policy administration. Experience with endpoint security, software packaging and application deployment. Proven ability to investigate and resolve complex Level 2 and Level 3 incidents autonomously. Experience coordinating technical suppliers and working with multidisciplinary stakeholders. Ability to create clear technical and end-user documentation. Strong problem-solving skills and the maturity to take ownership of issues through to resolution. Fluent Portuguese and English, both written and spoken. Availability to work on-site in Lisbon. Valued Experience Experience supporting workplace services across multiple countries, locations or globally distributed teams. Experience with workplace automation and service standardisation. Knowledge of printing management solutions such as Canon uniFLOW. Experience supporting meeting-room technologies, including Logitech or ScreenBeam solutions. Experience supporting enterprise mobile device environments. Participation in proofs of concept, large-scale endpoint rollouts or workplace lifecycle projects. Previous experience in the aerospace, space technology, aviation, defence or advanced engineering sectors. review_candidates.title: Senior Storage Engineer - Everpure FlashBlade and FlashArray
review_candidates.description: CMK Resources is seeking a Senior Pure Storage Resident Engineer to support one of our strategic technology partners and their end customer, a major financial services organization. This is a highly visible, hands-on engineering role supporting a large and complex enterprise storage environment across Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray. We are specifically looking for an engineer with strong, hands-on production experience with BOTH Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray. Candidates must have personally administered, supported, optimized, and troubleshot both platforms in enterprise environments. This is not an architecture-only, implementation-only, or pre-sales position. The ideal candidate is a senior operational storage engineer with deep expertise across file, object, and block storage, including S3, and the troubleshooting skills to independently own complex production issues. This is also a true Resident Engineer position. You will work directly alongside the customer, take ownership of technical issues and optimization initiatives, and become a trusted technical advisor within their storage organization. What You Will Be Doing Provide hands-on administration, operational support, troubleshooting, and optimization of Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray in a large enterprise production environment. Troubleshoot complex storage issues involving performance, latency, availability, capacity, connectivity, access, and application workloads. Support S3/object storage environments, including APIs, buckets, authentication, permissions, performance, and application connectivity. Administer and troubleshoot enterprise file services, including NFS and SMB/CIFS. Support enterprise block storage workloads on Pure FlashArray, including SAN connectivity and performance. Perform proactive health checks, performance analysis, capacity planning, monitoring, and optimization across the Pure environment. Support multi-tenant environments, including RBAC, access policies, authentication, and tenant separation. Manage and troubleshoot snapshots, replication, data protection, high availability, and disaster recovery. Support upgrades, maintenance activities, infrastructure changes, migrations, and lifecycle management. Perform deep root cause analysis using logs, metrics, alerts, and system behavior rather than relying solely on vendor escalation. Work across storage, VMware, Linux, networking, backup, security, database, cloud, and application teams to resolve complex infrastructure issues. Participate in incident management, change management, maintenance windows, and major production events. Identify opportunities to improve storage performance, reliability, utilization, and operational efficiency. Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and best practices. Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the customer, proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements. What You Bring to the Role 8+ years of enterprise storage engineering experience supporting large, business-critical production environments. Hands-on Pure Storage FlashBlade experience is required. Hands-on Pure Storage FlashArray experience is required. Demonstrated experience administering and troubleshooting both FlashBlade and FlashArray in production environments. Strong hands-on experience across file, object, and block storage. Strong knowledge of S3/object storage, including troubleshooting workloads, APIs, access, permissions, and performance. Strong experience with NFS and SMB/CIFS. Strong understanding of enterprise SAN/block storage concepts and troubleshooting. Experience troubleshooting storage performance, latency, capacity, availability, connectivity, and access issues. Experience with storage monitoring, observability, health checks, capacity planning, and performance optimization. Understanding of multi-tenancy, RBAC, access policies, authentication, and security within enterprise storage environments. Experience with snapshots, replication, high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection. Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments, ideally at the petabyte scale. Experience with VMware and enterprise virtualized environments. Strong Linux troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues across storage, host, network, and application layers. Experience operating within formal enterprise incident, change, and problem management processes. Customer-Facing Experience Technical expertise alone will not be enough for this position. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating as a Resident Engineer and trusted technical advisor within a large enterprise customer. You should have experience: Working directly with enterprise customers or internal infrastructure stakeholders. Taking ownership of complex technical issues from initial investigation through resolution. Leading technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis discussions. Communicating effectively during high-severity production incidents. Providing proactive recommendations rather than operating solely in a reactive support capacity. Presenting technical risks, findings, and best practices to customer stakeholders. Building credibility and long-term relationships with engineering teams. Working independently while effectively engaging vendor engineering and support resources when necessary.
